command: import json,sys,site,importlib.metadata as m; from pathlib import Path; p=Path(sys.prefix); print(json.dumps({"prefix_differs_from_base":sys.prefix!=sys.base_prefix,"user_site_enabled":site.ENABLE_USER_SITE,"pyvenv_cfg":(p/"pyvenv.cfg").read_text(encoding="utf-8"),"packages":sorted([{"name":d.metadata["Name"],"version":d.version,"inside_environment":Path(d.locate_file("")).resolve().is_relative_to(p)} for d in m.distributions()],key=lambda r:r["name"])}))
